scope: Platform reference facts for interpreting evidence, not evidence that a given game uses a facility. Community primary technical documentation; not a Nintendo specification.
inferences_for_mining: Interpret DISPCNT mode traces as scoped rendering evidence, not gameplay genre.
Decode bitmap candidates using observed mode, palette and frame dimensions; filenames alone are insufficient.
RAM code may be copied or overlaid; ROM-address function discovery does not identify all runtime RAM routines.
